name: update_token_info
description: Update API token for a specific user. NOTE: when 'regenerate' is set, the returned token value needs to be stored as it cannot be retrieved afterwards!

pathParams.name: userid
pathParams.description: Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format.

params.name: delete
params.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

params.name: expire
params.description: API token expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date.

params.name: privsep
params.description: Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default), or give full privileges of corresponding user.

params.name: regenerate
params.description: Regenerate the token's secret value. All users of the previous secret will lose access after this operation.

expire.description: API token expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date.

full-tokenid.description: The full token id. Only set when 'regenerate' was set.

privsep.description: Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default), or give full privileges of corresponding user.

value.description: API token value used for authentication. Only set when 'regenerate' was set.
